c1-23-goethe-mini-3.intro: Finalizing a research paper before submission, Nadine praises Timo's condensed, precise text — naturally recycling adjective declension, comparison, relative clauses, participial attributes, and complex nominal groups.
c1-23-goethe-mini-3.scene: Letzte Überarbeitung eines Forschungsartikels vor der Einreichung

c1-24-nominalisierung-im-formellen-stil.lastLine: anden . Ich formuliere den Vorschlag gleich .
c1-24-nominalisierung-im-formellen-stil.intro: After feedback from their supervisor, Marte and Timo weigh when nominal style sharpens their research paper's precision — the analysis of the documents, the necessity of a further audit — and when it just gets in the reader's way.
c1-24-nominalisierung-im-formellen-stil.scene: Überarbeitung einer Forschungsarbeit nach Rückmeldung der Betreuerin

c1-25-partizipien-und-adjektive-als-nome.lastLine: Gut , dann rufe ich den Notarzt an .
c1-25-partizipien-und-adjektive-als-nome.intro: Preparing a university event, Frauke and Timo respond to a slightly injured participant — the injured person, the responsible person already caring for her — substantivized adjectives and participles standing in for the noun entirely.

c1-26-passiv-und-passiversatzformen.lastLine: ann kann wir den Bericht morgen abschließen .
c1-26-passiv-und-passiversatzformen.intro: Editing a scientific article, Karla and Timo decide sentence by sentence whether the passive, or a more natural alternative, best fits — the data being evaluated now, the protocol everyone must follow.

c1-27-funktionsverbgefuege-im-akademisch.intro: Before an international conference, Wenke and Timo weigh a hiring decision — the candidate's contribution, his research's role, his experience abroad — trading plain verbs for the noun-plus-light-verb constructions academic German prefers.
c1-27-funktionsverbgefuege-im-akademisch.scene: Überarbeitung eines Forschungsartikels vor einer internationalen Konferenz

c1-28-goethe-mini-4.lastLine: Dann drücke ich dir die Daumen .
c1-28-goethe-mini-4.intro: Finalizing a research paper for publication, Merit must review the documents and postpone an appointment, while Timo stays confident it'll go in on time — recycling nominalization, passive alternatives, and Funktionsverbgefüge together.
c1-28-goethe-mini-4.scene: Letzte Überarbeitung eines Forschungsartikels vor der Veröffentlichung

c1-29-verben-mit-praefixen-sicher-unters.intro: Preparing presentations on a painting, Yara wants to describe it more precisely and Timo suggests portraying the artist's technique instead — choosing between prefix verbs from the same root, schreiben, stellen, ziehen, by context, not memorization.

c1-30-nomen-mit-numerusbesonderheiten.lastLine: Worte des Vorschlags müssen ergänzt werden .
c1-30-nomen-mit-numerusbesonderheiten.intro: Reviewing official documents for a research project, Insa notes the costs are high and the staff too few, while Timo realizes a single word is missing from the form — nouns that exist only in singular, only in plural, or that shift meaning with number.
c1-30-nomen-mit-numerusbesonderheiten.scene: Vorbereitung eines Forschungsprojekts und Durchsicht amtlicher Dokumente

c1-31-adversativangaben-und-gegensaetze-.lastLine: Gut , dann suchen wir einen Kompromiss .
c1-31-adversativangaben-und-gegensaetze-.intro: Preparing opposing viewpoints for a university debate on artificial intelligence, Meike calls the bike path expensive but sensible, and Timo insists it's worth it despite the cost — choosing the right bridge between contrasting ideas, not just "aber".
c1-31-adversativangaben-und-gegensaetze-.scene: Vorbereitung einer Universitätsdebatte über künstliche Intelligenz

c1-32-kohaerenz-und-textverknuepfung.lastLine: ut , dann überarbeite ich den Absatz gleich .
c1-32-kohaerenz-und-textverknuepfung.intro: Editing the structure of a university thesis, Britta flags weak coherence and Timo works on the paragraph transitions and reference chains — not fixing grammar, but connecting every sentence into one continuous train of thought.

c1-33-goethe-mini-5.intro: Preparing a research presentation and paper for an international conference, Doreen checks her talk once more and Timo commits to making an important contribution — recycling prefix verbs, number-sensitive nouns, adversative structures, and cohesive discourse.
c1-33-goethe-mini-5.scene: Vorbereitung einer Forschungspräsentation für eine internationale Konferenz

c1-34-argumentieren-auf-c1-niveau.intro: Preparing for a Goethe C1 debate on whether AI should transform university teaching, Wibke argues remote teaching is sensible, and Timo objects that interaction is missing — building a full argument with evidence, counter-argument, and refutation, not just an opinion.
c1-34-argumentieren-auf-c1-niveau.scene: Vorbereitung auf eine Goethe C1 Debatte über künstliche Intelligenz im Hochschulunterricht

c1-35-konzession-und-abwaegen.lastLine: , dann unterschreibe ich den Vertrag morgen .
c1-35-konzession-und-abwaegen.intro: Preparing a seminar on renewable energy, Nadja agrees fundamentally with a merger while Timo concedes its advantages but flags the small figures — weighing benefits, drawbacks, and limitations like scientists, not lawyers defending one side.
c1-35-konzession-und-abwaegen.scene: Vorbereitung eines Seminars über erneuerbare Energien

c1-36-register-und-stilebenen-beherrsche.lastLine: ich mich beobachten , bevor ich etwas sage .
c1-36-register-und-stilebenen-beherrsche.intro: Before a business dinner, Solveig briefs Timo on the formal dress code and how to address the director — preparing the same information five different ways, for friends, an email, a presentation, a report, and a formal application.
c1-36-register-und-stilebenen-beherrsche.scene: Vorbereitung mehrerer Versionen derselben Information für verschiedene Zielgruppen

c1-37-kollokationen-und-bedeutungsnuance.lastLine: Gut , dann ergreifen wir sofort Maßnahmen .
c1-37-kollokationen-und-bedeutungsnuance.intro: Revising an academic article before submission, Petra says they must take measures right away, and Timo regards the situation as critical — not fixing grammar, but making sure every word pairs with its natural collocation partner.
c1-37-kollokationen-und-bedeutungsnuance.scene: Überarbeitung eines wissenschaftlichen Artikels vor der Einreichung

c1-38-zusammenfassung-schreiben.lastLine: dann schreibe ich die Zusammenfassung jetzt .
c1-38-zusammenfassung-schreiben.intro: Preparing for a university exam, Renke asks Timo for the main idea of a difficult-childhood chapter, and they agree to paraphrase rather than quote — packing only the essentials, without changing what the author intended.
c1-38-zusammenfassung-schreiben.scene: Vorbereitung auf eine Universitätsprüfung: Forschungsartikel zusammenfassen

c1-39-stellungnahme-schreiben.lastLine: dann schreibe ich die Stellungnahme gleich .
c1-39-stellungnahme-schreiben.intro: Preparing for the Goethe C1 Writing exam on whether AI should change exams, Alina states her view clearly while Timo weighs the reasons against it — writing like a judge, not a fan, toward one balanced conclusion.
c1-39-stellungnahme-schreiben.scene: Vorbereitung auf die Goethe C1 Schreibprüfung: Soll künstliche Intelligenz Prüfungen verändern?

c1-40-forumsbeitrag-schreiben.lastLine: ir können den Beitrag jetzt veröffentlichen .
c1-40-forumsbeitrag-schreiben.intro: Joining an online university forum on whether AI should partially replace homework, Merle opens with a friendly greeting and Timo responds to frustrated users calmly — keeping the discussion objective, like a conversation in writing.
c1-40-forumsbeitrag-schreiben.scene: Teilnahme an einer Universitätsforum-Diskussion: Soll künstliche Intelligenz Hausaufgaben teilweise ersetzen?

c1-41-grafikbeschreibung-und-grafikauswe.lastLine: t , dann präsentieren wir die Grafik morgen .
c1-41-grafikbeschreibung-und-grafikauswe.intro: Preparing a university presentation on AI, climate change, and digitalization statistics, Katrin describes rising revenue over three years, and Timo offers a possible explanation — reading the graphic like data analysts, not calculators.
c1-41-grafikbeschreibung-und-grafikauswe.scene: Vorbereitung auf eine Universitätspräsentation: Statistiken zu KI, Klimawandel und Digitalisierung analysieren

c1-42-goethe-zertifikat-c1-probepruefung.intro: At the Goethe Institute for their C1 exam, Ines admits her exam anxiety despite intensive preparation, and Timo walks her through how the evaluation runs — naturally recycling every skill from the chapters before.
c1-42-goethe-zertifikat-c1-probepruefung.scene: Am Goethe-Institut: Anmeldung, Wartezeit und die C1-Prüfung

c1-43-goethe-zertifikat-c1-final.lastLine: Ich bin stolz auf unsere gemeinsame Reise .
c1-43-goethe-zertifikat-c1-final.intro: Wenke and Timo have just finished the Goethe-Zertifikat C1 exam — she's achieved her certification, and they reflect on the road to C2 ahead, proud of the shared journey that got them here.
c1-43-goethe-zertifikat-c1-final.scene: Nach der Goethe-Zertifikat C1 Prüfung: Rückblick und Zukunftspläne

c2-01-zeitformen-der-verben.intro: Editing the narration of a historical documentary set in 1989, Constanze reads Timo the opening in the historical present — discovering how a single tense choice changes atmosphere, objectivity, and literary style.

c2-02-verben-mit-praefixen.lastLine: t . Dann reichen wir den Bericht morgen ein .
c2-02-verben-mit-praefixen.intro: Editing a university research article, Merit has thoroughly analyzed the data and Timo asks her to set out the core claim — replacing ordinary verbs with sharper prefix verbs at every turn, weighing meaning, register, and precision.

c2-03-verben-und-ihre-ergaenzungen.lastLine: Dann bist du auf dem richtigen Weg .
c2-03-verben-und-ihre-ergaenzungen.intro: Revising her master's thesis, Almut has been reflecting for weeks on how it ties to older studies, and Timo asks whether her new approach connects to practice — repeatedly restructuring verb complements for clarity and academic style.

c2-04-nomen-verb-verbindungen.lastLine: bernehme die Verantwortung für den Nachweis .
c2-04-nomen-verb-verbindungen.intro: Revising a master's thesis, Henrike insists a decision must be brought about today, and Timo voices criticism of the procedure — trading simple verbs for their more formal noun-verb twins throughout.

c2-05-goethe-mini-1.lastLine: h bin zuversichtlich , dass du das schaffst .
c2-05-goethe-mini-1.intro: The night before her defense, Roswitha reflects on one point she still doubts, and Timo asks her to set it out more precisely — the first full performance of tense selection, prefix verbs, complements, and nominal style together.

c2-06-konjunktiv-ii.intro: Preparing a proposal for an international research conference, Christel and Timo keep reformulating direct statements — it would be sensible, one could suspect — turning Konjunktiv II into a dimmer switch for how strongly they commit to each claim.

c2-07-konjunktiv-i.lastLine: nd lassen jede Stimme zu Wort kommen lassen .
c2-07-konjunktiv-i.intro: Writing a newspaper article on a controversial political event, Ortrud reports the minister postulates the reform is necessary, and Timo insists on reporting neutrally, letting every voice speak through invisible quotation marks: Konjunktiv I.
c2-07-konjunktiv-i.scene: Redaktion eines Zeitungsartikels über ein umstrittenes politisches Ereignis

c2-08-modalverben.lastLine: , dann führen wir einen weiteren Test durch .
c2-08-modalverben.intro: Drafting a policy recommendation for an international organization, Waltraud calls their hypothesis plausible while Timo insists the probability of an error feels very real — the same modal verb changing the lens of certainty, not the facts underneath.
c2-08-modalverben.scene: Vorbereitung einer Politikempfehlung für eine internationale Organisation

c2-09-goethe-mini-2.lastLine: r haben noch Zeit bis zum Redaktionsschluss .
c2-09-goethe-mini-2.intro: Preparing together for the official Goethe C2 mock exam, Brunhilde reports a minister's declared success and Timo insists on verifying it before printing — coordinating newspaper, academic, political, and scientific registers like a symposium conductor.
c2-09-goethe-mini-2.scene: Gemeinsame Vorbereitung auf die offizielle Goethe-C2-Simulationsprüfung

c2-10-adverbialsaetze-und-diskursmarker.lastLine: ut , dann fassen wir unsere Punkte zusammen .
c2-10-adverbialsaetze-und-diskursmarker.intro: Revising a Goethe C2 essay on rising rents, Gudrun links cause to consequence — accordingly, nevertheless, hence — and Timo adds his own couplings, discourse markers holding every paragraph-carriage of the argument together.

c2-11-relativsaetze.intro: Editing a university dissertation, Adelheid isn't convinced by a theory that the market regulates itself, and Timo points to the three-country data behind it — packaging every relative clause as precisely and elegantly as a note inside a gift box.

c2-12-passiv.intro: Editing a scientific research paper, Isolde and Timo decide sentence by sentence where to point the camera — active, passive, or nominal style — as the stable values are established and the hypothesis holds.

c2-13-passiversatzformen.lastLine: ist der Entwurf vergleichbar mit dem alten .
c2-13-passiversatzformen.intro: Editing a doctoral dissertation on bridge design, Regine asks whether the new design is realizable, and Timo confirms it's heavily load-bearing and well scalable — choosing the right road through the whole network of passive alternatives, not just one highway.

c2-14-goethe-halbzeit-test.lastLine: in der zweiten Hälfte genauer nachforschen .
c2-14-goethe-halbzeit-test.intro: Taking a complete Goethe C2 mock exam together, Dorothea reports a government's claim that a study is reproducible, and Timo insists on running his own analysis — the last equipment check before the final ascent.

c2-15-partizipien-als-adjektive.intro: Editing a university dissertation, Sieglinde calls the work groundbreaking and Timo finds the argumentation well-founded — replacing relative clauses with compact participial adjectives, a backpack instead of a suitcase.

c2-16-nominalisierte-adjektive-und-parti.lastLine: entliche ist , dass die Beweislage klar ist .
c2-16-nominalisierte-adjektive-und-parti.intro: Editing a government policy paper in a courtroom setting, Ilse counts the interviewees and injured people already waiting, and Timo asks who's responsible for the protocol — nominalized adjectives and participles keeping the label, dropping the person.

c2-17-adjektivdeklination-auf-c2-niveau.lastLine: Gut , dann reiche ich den Antrag morgen ein .
c2-17-adjektivdeklination-auf-c2-niveau.intro: Editing a doctoral dissertation, Traudl wants to describe a newly developed medical method more precisely, and Timo points to the recently published results supporting it — organizing every adjective into its exact orbit around the noun.

c2-18-stilistische-nuancen-und-register-.lastLine: Gut , dann passe ich den ganzen Text an .
c2-18-stilistische-nuancen-und-register-.intro: Editing a publishing-house manuscript, Hildegard corrects Timo's plain "big" to "massive", and guides him toward "considerable" for legal contexts and "significant" for study results — choosing the exact shade of meaning, not just a correct adjective.

c2-19-adjektive-mit-ergaenzungen.lastLine: de verpflichtet zu einer gemeinsamen Lösung .
c2-19-adjektive-mit-ergaenzungen.intro: Working on an international research proposal, Elfriede says she's ready for an agreement and determined to take the step, and Timo asks if she's capable of compromise — every adjective here a magnet pulling in its own required complement.

c2-20-goethe-mini-3.intro: Revising a research publication meant to become an article, a report, and a conference talk, Kordula notices Timo's nominalization has improved, though participial attributes still challenge him — conducting the whole grammar orchestra from Chapters 1–19 at once.

c2-21-wortbildung-der-adjektive.lastLine: anden . Dann erstellen wir einen neuen Plan .
c2-21-wortbildung-der-adjektive.intro: Naming the terms of an interdisciplinary research project, Ottilie insists their concept must be future-proof, and Timo pushes for energy-efficient, customer-oriented processes — building each adjective from root, prefix, and suffix like LEGO bricks.

c2-22-wortbildung-der-nomen.lastLine: ann formuliere ich die Fragestellung gleich .
c2-22-wortbildung-der-nomen.intro: Drafting terminology for a European Union research project, Marlies insists the climate-protection law needs a clear legal basis, and Timo asks what knowledge gain they expect — every compound noun a train whose last carriage decides everything.

c2-23-wortbildung-der-verben.lastLine: Der Vorstand muss das erst ratifizieren .
c2-23-wortbildung-der-verben.intro: Editing a university publication, Cordula pushes to digitalize the whole system, and Timo suggests structuring the processes first — replacing vague verbs with richer derived ones, root as trunk, prefix as branch, suffix as leaf.

c2-24-goethe-mini-4.intro: Adapting the same research findings into a journal article, a conference talk, a policy report, and a newspaper piece, Wibke worries the title's compound word sounds unwieldy, and Timo suggests loosening the register — designing a whole city, not just one correct house.
c2-24-goethe-mini-4.scene: Vorbereitung eines Publikationspakets für ein Forschungsinstitut

c2-25-appositionen.lastLine: ine Sorge . Ich überarbeite den Text gleich .
c2-25-appositionen.intro: Editing an academic article, Jutta and Timo replace long relative clauses naming the author and the chancellor with elegant appositions — a business card pinned right next to each name badge.

c2-26-nominalstil.lastLine: ke ! Die Bevölkerung wird davon profitieren .
c2-26-nominalstil.intro: Preparing a research paper for publication, Angelika asks for more nominal style, and Timo turns "we investigate that" into "die Untersuchung des Themas" — trading the step-by-step video of Verbstil for the single compact photograph of Nominalstil.
c2-26-nominalstil.scene: Überarbeitung eines Forschungspapiers vor der Veröffentlichung

c2-27-kollokationen-und-idiomatik.lastLine: Einverstanden . Lass uns den Erfolg feiern !
c2-27-kollokationen-und-idiomatik.intro: Celebrating a successful campaign, Bettina says it made headlines and Timo claims they're on the pulse of the times — replacing grammatically correct but unnatural phrasing with the collocations native speakers actually reach for.

c2-28-praepositionen-der-schriftsprache.lastLine: esem Verfahren sollten wir geduldig bleiben .
c2-28-praepositionen-der-schriftsprache.intro: Requesting a deadline extension from their university, Ursel writes "against this background" and Timo adds "pursuant to the law" — trading everyday prepositions for the formal ones a university, courtroom, or ministry expects.
c2-28-praepositionen-der-schriftsprache.scene: Überarbeitung eines Forschungsantrags vor der Einreichung

c2-29-goethe-c2-final.lastLine: Und jetzt stehen wir endlich auf dem Gipfel .
c2-29-goethe-c2-final.intro: In their last revision before the official Goethe C2 exam, Adelinde argues the data prove their thesis correct, and Timo confirms the connection between every variable — not learning anything new, just proving they can use it all, confidently, anywhere.
